title: Cloud And Accounts Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan for approval · cloud sessions list and accounts clean-up, both approved 1A 2A 3A
approval: Build plan approved: cloud sessions list, accounts clean-up

short.lead: Five steps build the two designs you approved, on the same branch as the 0.4.0 fixes. Three steps are under #39 (Cloud sessions in the session list) and two under #43 (Accounts clean-up). Nothing changes inside a Claude folder. The cloud steps are tested against a stand-in server, because no real signed-in account is available on the build machine.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it makes and how it is checked.
items: desktop/cloud.js reads each account's sign-in token from .credentials.json, never writing it, and asks Anthropic's server for that account's cloud sessions every 30 seconds. Archived sessions are dropped. Each account gets a plain status: ok, no sign-in, expired, or the error message itself.
Nothing. Checked by tests covering a good answer, archived entries, an expired token, a refused token (error 401), no network and no credentials file.
Cloud sessions join their project's group by repository name, with a cloud icon. Tapping one opens a pane with Open on claude.ai and Continue on this PC, which runs claude --teleport in that account.
Nothing. Checked in the real app with a stand-in server and a stand-in claude command.
An expired or refused token shows Sign-in out of date on that account, with Refresh, which runs claude auth status in that account and reads again.
Nothing. Checked in the real app with a stand-in claude command.

More, then Accounts…, lists each folder with its email, folder name, session count and Hide. Folders that share an email are marked. Hidden folders are saved in the app's own settings file and left out everywhere, with Show again to bring them back.
Nothing. Checked in the real app with three fake folders, two sharing an email, including after a restart.
Every session row starts its second line with an account badge. A line at the top of the list says which accounts are shown and how many sessions, and narrows to one account when tapped.
Nothing. Checked in the real app with three fake accounts.
Then I build all five steps and send one QA page covering them and the other fixes.
